strings.zh: 真不知道公司为什么{NEWLINE}把我安排到研发部,{CLEAR}我压根就不懂这方面的东西。{CLEAR}好在主管一直没有给我安排具体工作,{CLEAR}只是要我每天{CLEAR}给其他同事倒倒水什么的。
strings.en: I have no idea why the company put me in{NEWLINE}R&D.{SCROLL}I don’t know the first thing about this{NEWLINE}stuff.{SCROLL}Luckily, my supervisor never gives me{NEWLINE}any real work.{SCROLL}I just pour water for my coworkers{NEWLINE}every day and stuff.
strings.notes: Bank is Silph Co. offices (西鲁夫公司), not Cerulean/Route 24. #0-12 normal, #17-23 Rocket occupation, #24-31 post-game League takeover.

strings.zh: 小美真的好漂亮好温柔啊,{NEWLINE}每天还主动给我倒水喝。{CLEAR}能坐在小美的后面看着她的背影,{CLEAR}我真是太幸福了。{SCROLL}我要竭尽全力地做好工作,{NEWLINE}得到主管的表扬,{CLEAR}然后成功吸引到小美。
strings.en: Mei is so pretty and so sweet.{SCROLL}She even brings me water every day{NEWLINE}without being asked.{SCROLL}Sitting behind her and gazing at her{NEWLINE}back makes me so happy.{SCROLL}I’m going to work as hard as I can, get{NEWLINE}praised by the boss,{SCROLL}and win Mei’s heart.
strings.notes: 小美 here = Mei (generic coworker; not Molly Hale).

strings.zh: 我在跟柑果球大师岩铁先生访谈时,{NEWLINE}发现了机械精灵球和柑果精灵球{CLEAR}优势融合的可能性。{CLEAR}我现在正在研究通过生物机械工程{CLEAR}做出能将两者优势融合的精灵球。{CLEAR}如果成功了,{CLEAR}那将是精灵球研发史上最伟大的发明。
strings.en: When I interviewed Kurt, the Apricorn{NEWLINE}Ball master, I realized we might combine{CLEAR}the strengths of mechanical Poké Balls{CLEAR}and Apricorn Balls.{SCROLL}Now I’m researching a Poké Ball{NEWLINE}that fuses the two through{CLEAR}biomechanical engineering.{SCROLL}If it works, it’ll be the greatest{NEWLINE}invention in the history{CLEAR}of Poké Ball development.

strings.zh: 我们研发部的那个小美,{NEWLINE}真是个中看不中用的花瓶。{CLEAR}连树果的有效成分分离{CLEAR}这种基本的操作都不会。
strings.en: That Mei in our R&D department is just a{NEWLINE}pretty face. All looks, totally useless.{SCROLL}She can’t even do basic stuff{NEWLINE}like isolating the active{CLEAR}compounds in Berries.
strings.notes: tone review: 中看不中用的花瓶 = sexist 'just a pretty face… useless'; kept (D-0627); layout rebalance 2026-10-09 (prompt icons / single-word page)

strings.zh: 我是4楼销售部的,感觉跟5楼这些{NEWLINE}醉心研究的书呆子格格不入。
strings.en: I’m from Sales on 4F.{SCROLL}I feel so out of place among these{NEWLINE}research-obsessed bookworms on 5F.

strings.zh: 我原来跟其他同事一样,{NEWLINE}为了能够引起小美的注意而拼命工作,{CLEAR}可是自从有一天{CLEAR}一位同事累死在工作岗位上之后,{CLEAR}我就决定{CLEAR}再也不去追求这些虚无的东西了。
strings.en: I used to work myself to the bone like{NEWLINE}everyone else,{SCROLL}trying to catch Mei’s eye.{SCROLL}But then one day, a coworker worked{NEWLINE}himself to death at his desk.{SCROLL}After that, I decided I’d never chase{NEWLINE}such empty things again.

strings.zh: 你好,我是研发部的主管。{NEWLINE}能进入我们西鲁夫公司研发部的{CLEAR}都是万里挑一的科研精英。
strings.en: Hello, I’m the head of R&D.{SCROLL}Everyone who makes it into Silph Co.’s{NEWLINE}R&D department is one in ten thousand:{CLEAR}the elite of science.

strings.zh: 我们西鲁夫公司的员工,{NEWLINE}个个都是西装笔挺的精英,{CLEAR}跟大街上那种修消防管道的苦力{CLEAR}可不是一个阶级的。
strings.en: We Silph Co. employees are all{NEWLINE}sharp-suited elites.{SCROLL}We’re a class above those laborers{NEWLINE}fixing fire hydrants in the street.

strings.zh: 在窗明几净的办公大楼里{NEWLINE}一边悠闲地喝着咖啡{CLEAR}一边慢条斯理地办公,{CLEAR}这样高端又轻松的工作真的好棒！
strings.en: Sipping coffee at my leisure in a{NEWLINE}spotless office tower, taking my sweet{CLEAR}time with the work...{SCROLL}A classy, easy job like this is the best!

strings.zh: 达马兰奇主席和西鲁夫社长{NEWLINE}到底谈了什么呢,{CLEAR}未来的西鲁夫公司会有什么变化呢。
strings.en: What did President Goodshow and the{NEWLINE}president of Silph talk about, I wonder?{SCROLL}How will Silph Co. change from here?

strings.zh: 我们现在的社长{NEWLINE}是从他父亲那里继承的西鲁夫公司。{CLEAR}这个社长年轻的时候{CLEAR}经常花大价钱买异色的精灵炫富,{CLEAR}还拿着他父亲的钱自己开公司{CLEAR}结果败了个精光。{SCROLL}我这么努力地学习工作,{NEWLINE}到头来却只能给这种废材当下属,{CLEAR}想想真是不甘心啊。
strings.en: Our current president inherited Silph{NEWLINE}Co. from his father.{SCROLL}When he was young, he’d blow fortunes{NEWLINE}on Shiny Pokémon just to show off.{SCROLL}He even started a company with his{NEWLINE}dad’s money and lost every penny.{SCROLL}I study and work so hard, and in the{NEWLINE}end I’m stuck working under a{CLEAR}good-for-nothing like that.{SCROLL}It really gets to me.

strings.zh: 欢迎光临西鲁夫公司,{NEWLINE}这里是公司的综合办公中心。
strings.en: Welcome to Silph Co. This is the{NEWLINE}company’s main office center.

strings.zh: 如果我能在石英大会上取得名次,{NEWLINE}就能当一名自由自在的精英训练家了。{CLEAR}可惜我没有这个本事,{CLEAR}所以西鲁夫公司对我来说{CLEAR}也算是个不错的归宿了。
strings.en: If I could place at the Indigo{NEWLINE}Conference,{SCROLL}I could be a free-spirited Ace Trainer.{SCROLL}Sadly, I don’t have what it takes, so{NEWLINE}Silph Co.{SCROLL}is a pretty good place for me to end up.

strings.zh: 笑脸来迎天下客,{NEWLINE}万金皆到囊中来。
strings.en: Greet every customer with a smile, and{NEWLINE}gold will pour into your purse.

strings.zh: 金钱诚可贵,{NEWLINE}信用价更高。
strings.en: Money is precious, but trust is worth{NEWLINE}even more.

strings.zh: 与客户交流的临时笔记。
strings.en: Notes from a meeting with a client.

strings.zh: 什么？你问我这里有没有{NEWLINE}一个叫翔太的员工？{CLEAR}有是有啦,不过他前段时间{CLEAR}因为自身原因死在公司了。{SCROLL}这家伙死的真不是时候,{NEWLINE}彻底拖慢了我们重大科研项目的进度。{CLEAR}为此社长都亲自发话了,{CLEAR}说这样不负责任的员工,{CLEAR}必须要让他的家属赔偿公司损失。
strings.en: What? You’re asking if we had an{NEWLINE}employee named Shota?{SCROLL}Yeah, we did. But a while back, he died{NEWLINE}at the office, for personal reasons.{SCROLL}The guy picked a terrible time to die.{SCROLL}It set our big research project way{NEWLINE}behind schedule.{SCROLL}The president himself weighed in: with an{NEWLINE}irresponsible employee like that, his{CLEAR}family has to pay the company back for{CLEAR}its losses.
strings.notes: 翔太 → Shota (invented; coworker who died of overwork). | RV019: grammar: reported speech made a full sentence

strings.zh: 我正在整理{NEWLINE}西鲁夫公司的交易档案,{CLEAR}你少来烦人！
strings.en: I’m sorting through Silph Co.’s{NEWLINE}transaction records. Quit bugging me!

strings.zh: 好吧,是你赢了。{NEWLINE}现在你可以滚远点{CLEAR}别来妨碍我工作了吗？
strings.en: Fine, you win. Now will you get lost and{NEWLINE}stop getting in the way of my work?

strings.zh: 根据电脑上的资料,{NEWLINE}西鲁夫公司有很多不清不楚的交易。{SCROLL}这个社长把自己包装成{NEWLINE}引领技术潮流的大商人,{CLEAR}背地里却是个唯利是图的贪婪鬼。
strings.en: According to the data on this computer,{NEWLINE}Silph Co. has plenty of shady deals.{SCROLL}The president plays the great{NEWLINE}businessman leading the tech trends...{SCROLL}But behind the scenes, he’s a greedy{NEWLINE}money-grubber.

strings.zh: 洗钱、走私、压榨员工、{NEWLINE}虚假宣传、以次充好、打压同行……{CLEAR}西鲁夫公司在创业初期{CLEAR}用尽了卑鄙的手段来积累财富。{SCROLL}看来拉西鲁夫社长入伙的事{NEWLINE}是十拿九稳了。
strings.en: Money laundering, smuggling, exploiting{NEWLINE}workers, false advertising, passing off{CLEAR}shoddy goods, crushing rivals...{SCROLL}In its early days, Silph Co.{SCROLL}used every dirty trick in the book to{NEWLINE}pile up its fortune.{SCROLL}Looks like getting the president to join{NEWLINE}us is in the bag.

strings.zh: 我在这里查到了很多{NEWLINE}西鲁夫公司的黑历史,{CLEAR}想知道的话就凭实力来问吧。
strings.en: I’ve dug up plenty of dirt on Silph Co.’s{NEWLINE}past here.{SCROLL}If you want to know, you’ll have to{NEWLINE}earn it with a battle.

strings.zh: 如果我也穿上制服加入火箭队,{NEWLINE}一定可以成为又美又飒的小仙女。{CLEAR}到时候想干嘛就干嘛,没人敢管我。
strings.en: If I put on the uniform and joined Team{NEWLINE}Rocket too,{SCROLL}I’d be a gorgeous, badass little fairy.{SCROLL}Then I could do whatever I want, and{NEWLINE}nobody would dare stop me.

strings.zh: 好期待火箭队统治世界的那天,{NEWLINE}到时候就是我们这些精英的天下了。
strings.en: I can’t wait for the day Team Rocket{NEWLINE}rules the world.{SCROLL}Then the world will belong to elites like{NEWLINE}us.

strings.zh: 精灵联盟居然把我们这些知识分子{NEWLINE}定义成跟修水管、扫大街的普通人{CLEAR}同样类型的工人,{CLEAR}简直是对我们所学知识的污辱！
strings.en: The Pokémon League classified{NEWLINE}intellectuals like us as the same kind of{CLEAR}workers as ordinary folks who fix pipes{CLEAR}and sweep streets!{SCROLL}It’s an insult to everything we studied!
strings.notes: | RV019: omission: 定义成…同样类型的工人 (classified as workers) restored; settles D-1875

strings.zh: 哼！自从公司被精灵联盟接管后,{NEWLINE}上班都不让戴昂贵的饰品了。{CLEAR}这样还怎么体现我高人一等的身份啊。
strings.en: Hmph! Ever since the Pokémon League{NEWLINE}took over the company,{SCROLL}we’re not allowed to wear expensive{NEWLINE}jewelry to work.{SCROLL}How am I supposed to show I’m a cut{NEWLINE}above everyone now?

strings.zh: 自从精灵联盟接管公司后,{NEWLINE}高管的收入大幅度缩水,{CLEAR}而我们这些普通员工的收入{CLEAR}却增长了不少呢。
strings.en: Since the Pokémon League took over the{NEWLINE}company, executive pay has shrunk a{CLEAR}lot, while we regular employees are{CLEAR}earning quite a bit more.

strings.zh: 现在的社长就是个吉祥物,{NEWLINE}公司的所有权和决策权{CLEAR}都归精灵联盟了。{CLEAR}以前那个喜欢指点江山的无能社长{CLEAR}如今整天畏缩在自己的办公室里,{CLEAR}都不愿意出来与我们见面。
strings.en: The president is just a mascot now. The{NEWLINE}Pokémon League owns the company and{CLEAR}makes all the decisions.{SCROLL}That useless president who loved{NEWLINE}lording it over everyone now cowers in{CLEAR}his office all day.{SCROLL}He won’t even come out to see us.

strings.zh: 公司突然通知我说{NEWLINE}要想留在研发部就得正经学技术,{CLEAR}看来再也不能像以前那样{CLEAR}靠颜值和身材混日子了。
strings.en: The company suddenly told me that if I{NEWLINE}want to stay in R&D, I have to actually{CLEAR}learn the technical stuff.{SCROLL}Looks like I can’t coast by on my looks{NEWLINE}and figure anymore.

strings.zh: 最近小美突然很恭敬地{NEWLINE}要我教她研发技术,{CLEAR}真是太阳打西边出来了。
strings.en: Lately, Mei has suddenly been asking me,{NEWLINE}all respectful, to teach her R&D skills.{SCROLL}Will wonders never cease!

strings.zh: 我们研发部原来的主管投靠了火箭队,{NEWLINE}现在由我担任主管。
strings.en: Our old head of R&D defected to Team{NEWLINE}Rocket. Now I’m the head.

strings.zh: 自从传送装置被关闭后,{NEWLINE}我再也没法第一个去食堂抢饭了。
strings.en: Ever since they shut down the warp{NEWLINE}panels, I can never be first to the{CLEAR}cafeteria anymore.

strings.zh: 这块地板上发出淡淡的光,{NEWLINE}好像可以通往另一个地方。
strings.en: This floor tile is giving off a faint glow.{SCROLL}It looks like it could take you{NEWLINE}somewhere else.

strings.zh: 水吾桐『我听说有入侵者,{NEWLINE}没想到竟然是你这小鬼。{CLEAR}不管你是怎么进来的,{CLEAR}只要见到我你就别想活着出去了！
strings.en: Archie: I heard there was an intruder,{NEWLINE}and it turns out to be you, brat.{SCROLL}I don’t care how you got in.{SCROLL}Now that you’ve seen me, you’re not{NEWLINE}leaving here alive!

strings.zh: 水吾桐『真没想到{NEWLINE}我会栽在你这小鬼手上,{CLEAR}既然你那么不自量力地想往前闯,{CLEAR}那你就沿着这条不归路继续前进{CLEAR}直到死亡为止吧。
strings.en: Archie: I never thought I’d lose to a{NEWLINE}brat like you.{SCROLL}Since you’re so foolishly set on pushing{NEWLINE}forward, go ahead...{SCROLL}Follow this road of no return, all the{NEWLINE}way to your death.
